sys-01-c2.text: Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau and Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau (2018). Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces, Chapter 22: Beyond Physical Memory: Policies. Arpaci-Dusseau Books (University of Wisconsin-Madison).
sys-01-c2.quote: The optimal replacement policy leads to the fewest number of misses overall.
sys-01-c2.claim: The optimal policy in hindsight, Belady's algorithm, evicts the item that will be needed furthest in the future.

sys-01-c1.quote: There are only two hard things in Computer Science: cache invalidation and naming things.
sys-01-c1.claim: There are only two hard things in computer science: cache invalidation and naming things
